**Analysis Summary:**

Test image features:
- Overall yellow-green (chlorotic) leaf
- Large, irregular dark brown-black blotches covering significant portions
- No distinct concentric rings (rules out Early_Blight, Target_Spot)
- No small circular spots (rules out Septoria, Bacterial_Spot)
- No webbing (rules out Spider_Mites)
- No powdery coating (rules out Powdery_Mildew)
- No mosaic/mottling pattern (rules out virus classes)
- No V-shaped marginal lesions (rules out Verticillium_Wilt)

**Late_Blight vs Early_Blight comparison:**
- Early_Blight reference shows dark lesions with concentric target-board rings + yellow halo — not matching the test image's irregular shapeless dark patches
- Late_Blight reference (bottom-right panel) shows a leaf on a gray background with large irregular dark brown-black blotches and significant yellowing — this closely matches the test image's pattern
- The large, amorphous dark patches spreading across the leaf without concentric rings is the hallmark of Late_Blight
